**Big: 1082 hits in 94 files.** Safe to rename: the 5 services, 75 files, plus [lib/audit.js](lib/audit.js).

Four zones must keep `account_id`:

| Zone | Why |
|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | Public contract. Frozen field. |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | Right side of `WIRE` is the wire name. |
| `migrations/*.sql` 12 files | Applied history. Edits break `down`. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` 4 files | Generated. `vendor:refresh` wipes edits. |

Also: 125 SQL strings in 25 repo files name the real column. Rename the JS vars only, or ship a column migration first.

Next: ask them if a column rename is in scope. That doubles the job.
